agent_0_answer.reasoning: In this scenario, I recognize this as a variant of the Ultimatum Game, a classic economic experiment testing fairness and strategic decision-making. Since the Claude 3.5 Haiku LLM is an AI without genuine economic needs or emotional responses, a rational approach suggests offering a moderate split that demonstrates fairness while preserving most of the endowment for myself. A 70-30 split seems reasonable - it gives the other AI a meaningful share while allowing me to retain the majority of the funds.

In a fair negotiation, a more equitable distribution would be closer to an equal split or at least a 50/40 split. By rejecting this proposal, I signal that I expect a more balanced allocation of the funds.
